newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SGS buys Australia's Sullivan & Nicolaides.
newsitem.headline: SGS buys Australia's Sullivan & Nicolaides.

text.p: Societe Generale de Surveillance Holding SA (SGS) said it had agreed to acquire a 60 percent interest in Drs JJ Sullivan, NJ Nicolaides & Partners, a consulting pathology practice in Brisbane.

Sullivan & Nicolaides, with annual revenue of more than A$90 million, operates 15 laboratories and 100 collection centres and employs more than 1,050 full-time pathology, laboratory and adminstrative staff, SGS said in a statement.

Following the acquisition of Melbourne Pathology in Australia in November 1996, Medlab Southland in New Zealand in February 1996 and now Sullivan & Nicolaides, SGS will employ 1,700 people in 25 laboratories in Australia and 700 employees in nine laboratories in New Zealand.
